decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Canopy now has a continuous curved silhouette above the harness.

rear.note: Frame, hinges and basket remain connected.

detail.note: Smooth canopy and sewn edge replace planar bands; the original coated blue material remains shiny.

underside.note: Closed canopy shell is visible above the unchanged seat and chassis.

clay.note: Clay confirms curved cover and continuous edge binding.

detail.note: Trap bends and coupling collars replace the abrupt angular assembly.

underside.note: A continuous P-shaped tube connects below the basin.

clay.note: Clay shows coherent exposed plumbing and unchanged console joinery.
